match.description: Callsigns this entry covers. "*" matches any run of characters.

profile.description: EuroScope profile name, without the .prf extension. Only needed where the profile cannot be worked out from the callsign.

airports.description: Airports this position controls, top-down, most important first. Only the first four that publish an ATIS can be turned on at once, so the order is the priority.

atis.description: Whether this position publishes an ATIS here. Default true. False is for a field it controls without running its ATIS.

runways_only.description: Airports somebody else controls whose runways this position still needs, so that its arrivals are configured in the EuroScope tags. They are active for arrivals only and never get an ATIS.

note.description: Free text, for example the agreement this follows.

position.description: The positions defined in this file.
